description: Server-side JavaScript code for a database visualization web application using Express.js. It loads environment variables, configures database clients for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB, and defines classes for database adapters and API endpoints for retrieving database info and data.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for database adapters, providing interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Base class for SQL database adapters, extending DatabaseAdapter, with methods for executing queries and retrieving table info.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, getDataQuery.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, getDataQuery.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, implementing execute, getTableQuery, getDataQuery, and testing connection.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, implementing connection, getTables, getData, and testing connection.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different databases.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and returns list of available ones.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing operations on specified database adapters.
